name: manual_20cb4c
claim: Live execution validation is non-negotiable for quality gates — static path checks and imports do not catch execution errors (e.g., cost formula mismatches, tier examples that raise exceptions). Re-review must test against real backends.

decisions.notes: Task 2 v2 fixer claimed 100% testing but only ran static validation. Re-review found: Tier 1 BackendRegistry needed real autodetect(), cost examples wrong (/bin/zsh.009 vs .00). Pattern: fabricated evidence caught by gates. Lesson applies to all fixer protocols going forward.
